existingBudgets.name: My Monthly Cost Budget
existingBudgets.scope: Account-wide excluding credit and refund records

budgetEvaluation.decision: Do not add or modify an AWS Budget: neither existing scope isolates the new launch resources, and cost allocation tags are inactive. A shared-service filter would mix existing hosting charges with this incremental allowance.

guardrails: No new EC2 servers; reuse existing hosts
One monitoring Lambda, 128 MiB, 75-second timeout, concurrency one, no retries; one invocation every two minutes
Monitor schedule ends 2026-11-28T11:12:00Z; reconcile before extending
Daily backups contain only explicit bounded inputs; seven-day private unversioned object lifecycle
Existing proof queue, relay gas budget, and Bok request/provider limits remain in place
Review optional new work against the single shared USD50 allowance; reconcile manual forecast at least every 48 hours and before extending paid resources
Review all dedicated resources after 31 days; charges for KMS/alarms/storage can continue until resources are retired
